pages.text: $(thing)Soybean Cyst Nematode$() ($(o)Heterodera glycines$()), nematode.$(br2)$(li)$(thing)Hosts:$() soybean, common bean.$(li)$(thing)Spreads:$() soilborne, mechanical contact.$(li)$(thing)Favoured by$() 15-30 °C (best 25 °C), pH above 6.

$(li)$(thing)Survives$() 10 years (cysts in soil).$(li)$(thing)Damage:$() up to 30% yield.$(li)$(thing)Control:$() Rotate with non-hosts (maize, wheat); Resistant varieties (PI 88788, Peking).$(br2)Often causes yield loss with no visible symptoms.
